csv_project_name: Design for Two Bicycle & Pedestrian Bridges
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Waukesha is seeking proposals and a statement of qualification from qualified firms for the design of two bicycle and pedestrian bridges across major state trunk highways in the City of Waukesha. The first pedestrian bridge would connect the 6-mile Fox River Trail over USH 18/STH 59 near the southwestern City limits. The second bicycle/pedestrian bridge would connect the New Berlin Trail over USH 18/STH 59/STH 164 on the eastern edge of the City limits. The City of Waukesha received a planning grant associated with the construction of two separate bicycle/pedestrian bridges over USH 18/STH 59 and USH 18/STH 59/STH 164.
csv_disciplines_requested: Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Feasibility Studies, Structural Engineering, Traffic Design Engineering
